knownBehavior: Eagle 4.0.0 writes a ZIP container with stored entries and pack.json at the root.
Items live in {itemId}.info directories with metadata.json, original media, and optional {itemName}_thumbnail.png.
A folder export stores one root folder object in pack.json.folder and nests descendants through children.
A selection export omits pack.json.folder and clears each item's folders array.
Folder exports preserve nested folder membership and repeated tags.
Eagle does not preserve Tag Groups when the package is imported.
unknowns: behavior for comments, video marks, archived pages, and multi-original items
format changes in Eagle releases other than 4.0.0
requiredSamples: one item with multiple files and a custom thumbnail

compatibilityAssertions: Do not treat an Eaglepack as a complete Eagle Library.
Read Eagle's singular pack.json.folder object and preserve its nested children.
Write Eagle's singular pack.json.folder object for folder exports.
Keep extraction limits, path validation, and symlink rejection fail-closed.
Record Eagle version, platform, sample checksum, and redaction steps with each sample.
Keep live or personal Eagle exports out of the repository.
The committed samples contain only generated media and example.com metadata.
